description: Production-grade frontend code generation for Claude artifacts and plugins. This skill is the code execution layer — it takes a confirmed design brief, locked tokens, and a brand profile and ships working, distinctive frontend code. Mandatory design gate runs before any code generation. Integrates with managing-design-briefs (Loxihart and FlashFusion profiles) and elite-ui-design (design system output). Use whenever the user asks to build a component, page, artifact, dashboard, landing page, or any UI — even casually. Triggers on: build this UI, make a component, create a dashboard, code this design, build the front end, artifact, Claude plugin, HTML, JSX, React, Tailwind, CSS, landing page, widget, card, panel, form, or any UI build request. Do NOT skip this skill just because the request seems small — a button component still needs a brief gate. Never generate code without running the design gate first.
